title: Audit learner search saved-entry deep link

spec.problem: Saved-item Search URLs include a target entry, but hydration removes the entry and the intended item is not selected automatically.

acceptance.text: Matching saved-entry links retain entry and automatically load the exact result detail.
Missing entry targets never silently select a different result or erase the requested identity.
Search remains usable at the existing 390x844 learner viewport.

spec.expected_behavior: A Search URL with a supported entry kind/id selects and loads the exact matching result after search completes, keeps entry in the URL, and never silently substitutes another result when the target is absent.
spec.observed_behavior: Visible authenticated 390x844 browser received /vi/search?entry=lexeme:<id>&q=<exact Japanese headword>; after GET /api/search returned the target ID, the URL became q-only and the user had to manually select the row.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the Search URL selection fix and its regression test.

red_targets.test: SearchClient saved-entry deep links > keeps the requested entry and loads its exact detail after search results arrive
SearchClient saved-entry deep links > does not replace a missing entry target with the first search result
SearchClient saved-entry deep links > honors an entry added to an already-mounted query without replacing its identity
